title: Tyler's machine room and ideas for biomedical inventions

tellings.quote: he says that he goes to a room where there's a machine and he doesn't know exactly what the machine does but he gets a lot of ideas about biomedical Innovations and goes on to actually start companies that are super successful

plain: A man known only as Tyler, said to be tied to a secret US space program, says he was taken to a room holding a machine whose purpose he did not understand. There he got many ideas for medical and biological inventions, and he went on to start very successful companies from them. Michels retells this from American Cosmic, a book by the religion scholar Diana Pasulka, in an episode with her, as a hint that hidden technology might be feeding real inventions.
